name: Daemon API contract changes update the API reference
instruction: A patch that changes the Daemon's public HTTP or MCP contract updates the doc page that owns that contract in the same patch.
relevant_when: A patch under src/server/ or src/daemon/error.rs adds or removes a route, returns a new response status or AoE-Error-Code value to clients, adds, renames or removes a field or enum value of a JSON request or response body, adds an MCP tool or a new value of an MCP result field, or changes a client-visible limit or timeout such as a size cap or wait duration.
context: AGENTS.md: update the documentation a change makes materially wrong or incomplete in the same PR, and Clients tell refusals apart by status and AoE-Error-Code. docs/api.md is the canonical HTTP and MCP reference, docs/plugin-api.md owns the plugin contract, and docs/development/internals/structured-view.md lists the ACP restart and view-switch refusals. Not in scope: internal refactors that keep the wire shape, logging or telemetry changes, test-only changes, and a refusal that reuses a status and error code pair the patch shows is already documented.
scope_reason: The rule pairs a server change with a companion docs change, which only the change's patch set shows together.

checklist.name: contract-change-documented
checklist.rule: For each contract change described in relevant_when, the patch also changes docs/api.md, docs/plugin-api.md or docs/development/internals/structured-view.md so that the new or changed route, status, error code, field, value or limit is described. Not applicable when the patch makes no such contract change.
